# Pilot — Uchicago building permits (Socrata)

**Real data.** Generated by `tools/adapters/permits-socrata.py`.

```bash
python3 tools/adapters/permits-socrata.py --city chicago --limit 60 \
  --out examples/pilot-chicago-permits
```

See [the Seattle pilot README](../pilot-seattle-permits/README.md) for the combined
findings — the two cities were converted together because they differ in exactly the way
the profile's disclosure stance was written for.
